<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Four [[Pakistan]]i police officers are shot dead by a [[Jamaat-ul-Ahrar]] splinter group. Three additional officers are injured. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-attack/four-police-killed-in-pakistan-ambush-claimed-by-taliban-splinter-group-idUSKCN1Q119Y (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*King [[Carl XVI Gustaf of Sweden]] confirms the election of [[Finland|Finnish]] writer and poet [[Tua Forsström]] as a new member of the [[Swedish Academy]], the body that formally decides the annual winner of the [[Nobel Prize in Literature]]. [https://www.svenskaakademien.se/en/press/the-swedish-academy-elects-a-new-member (Swedish Academy)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Delhi hotel fire]]
**At least 17 people are killed in a fire at a hotel in [[Delhi]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-47208379 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[Greece–North Macedonia relations]]
**The Republic of Macedonia officially changes its name to [[North Macedonia]], ending a long-standing [[Macedonia naming dispute|naming dispute]] with neighbouring [[Greece]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/12/nato-flag-raised-ahead-of-north-macedonias-prospective-accession (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]], in an interview with the [[BBC]]'s [[Orla Guerin]], accuses [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] of being openly a [[White supremacy|white supremacist]] who is "warmongering against [[Venezuela]]", saying that "the [[Ku Klux Klan]] is running the [[White House]]". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47209526 (BBC News)] [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/venezuelas-maduro-claims-extremist-trump-administration-is-ruled-by-ku-klux-klan-a4064861.html (''Evening Standard'')]

;Law and crime
*A Swedish district court rejects the application of a [[European arrest warrant]] to extradite from [[Sweden]] to [[Poland]] a [[History_of_Poland_(1945–1989)#Stalinist_era_(1948–56)|Stalinist-era judge]], [[Stefan Michnik]], suspected of issuing unlawful death sentences to underground fighters in the 1950s. [http://thenews.pl/1/10/Artykul/406146,Swedish-court-refuses-extradition-of-Stalinistera-judge-to-Poland (Radio Poland)]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis|Spanish constitutional crisis]], [[2017 Catalan independence referendum]] 
**The [[trial of Catalonia independence leaders]] starts at the [[Supreme Court of Spain|Spanish Supreme Court]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalan-leaders-go-on-trial-in-madrid-over-independence-bid-idUSKCN1Q01LD (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/02/12/world/europe/12reuters-spain-politics-catalonia.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/12/trial-of-catalan-separatist-leaders-begins-in-madrid (''The Guardian'')]
*''[[United States of America v. Joaquín Guzmán Loera]]''
**At his trial in a [[Brooklyn]] [[United States district court|federal court]], [[Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán]] is found guilty on all 10 counts; the charges include engaging in a continuing criminal enterprise, conspiracy to launder narcotics proceeds, international distribution of [[cocaine]], [[heroin]], [[marijuana]] and other drugs, and use of firearms during the commission of a felony. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/12/us/el-chapo-guzman-trial-verdict/index.html (CNN)]
*All 78 inmates escape from a prison in [[Aquin]], [[Haiti]], amid ongoing unrest in the country that has left four people dead. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47220832 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*Retired [[NASA]] astronaut [[Mark Kelly]] announces that he will run for the [[2020 United States Senate special election in Arizona]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/12/politics/mark-kelly-arizona-senate/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Jody Wilson-Raybould]] resigns as [[Canada]]'s [[Minister of Veterans Affairs (Canada)|Minister of Veterans Affairs]] less than one month into her term amid allegations she had been pressured by the [[Office of the Prime Minister (Canada)|Prime Minister's Office]] to go easy on [[SNC-Lavalin]] while she was [[Minister of Justice (Canada)|Minister of Justice]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-politics-snc-lavalin/canada-pm-surprised-minister-quit-cabinet-over-ethics-accusations-idUSKCN1Q12AZ (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*A wreck at the site of the [[Battle of the Santa Cruz Islands]] is identified as the [[WWII]]-era [[United States Navy|U.S. Naval]] [[aircraft carrier]] [[USS Hornet (CV-8)|USS ''Hornet'']]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/uss-hornet-wreckage-world-war-two-warship-discovered/ (CBS News)]

;Sports
*[[Rikako Ikee]], 18-year-old Japanese swimmer who won six gold medals at [[Swimming at the 2018 Asian Games|2018 Asian Games]], announces that she has been diagnosed with [[leukemia]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/12/sport/rikako-ikee-swimming-leukemia-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*North and South Korea announce they will launch a joint bid to host the [[2032 Summer Olympics]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/feb/12/north-and-south-korea-to-launch-joint-bid-to-host-2032-summer-olympics (''The Guardian'')]
